description: Publishes every draft document of a site at once: makes the .md URLs public and adds them to the site llms.txt. Show the user the list of drafts (list_documents) and get their approval first. On this account the call is refused until user_approved is true.

site.description: Site domain, e.g. example.com. Optional when the account has one site.

user_approved.description: True only after the user has seen this exact change in the chat and agreed to it.

name: publish_page_copies
title: Publish all draft copies
